async def act(page):
    # Click on the 'Reports' link to open its dropdown menu
    reports_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="Reports")
    await reports_link.click()
    # Wait for the menu to appear (assuming it expands)
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Brief pause for UI update
    # Click on the 'By Products' link under the reviews menu
    # Based on the tree, navigate through the menu structure
    by_products_link = page.get_by_role("menu").filter(has=page.get_by_role("menu").filter(has=page.get_by_role("link", name="By Products"))).get_by_role("link", name="By Products")
    await by_products_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    return
